_about: The student's research choice (GAD-T452, GAD-T606): the My research choice page, the organization's research invitation and the withdrawal notice (hashed as shown, so the record says which language was read), and the replies to a choice. English invitation text is ResearchConsentNotice's own wording; the English notice is still built there, word for word.
myResearch.none: Your organization isn't running any research with Gadfly at the moment, so there is nothing to choose. Your exams are not used for research.
myResearch.takingSince: (since {0}). Your de-identified exam records are included in copies made for the study.
myResearch.codeWhy: If the study team sends you a separate questionnaire, it may ask for this code so your answers can be matched to your exam records without your name.
myResearch.declined: You chose not to take part.
myResearch.notUsed: Your exam records are not used for research. You can change your mind below; it doesn't affect any exam.
myResearch.saveFailed: That could not be saved. Please try again.
research.invitation.title: Research (optional)
research.invitation.p1: {0} is running research ({1}) on how well this kind of spoken exam works: whether the AI examiner agrees with human graders, whether it is fair to different speakers, and whether feedback helps on a later attempt. You can choose whether your exam records are included. This is separate from the exam notice and entirely optional.
research.invitation.p2: Saying no, or not answering, changes nothing about your exam: you take the same exam, it is graded the same way, and no one grading you is told what you chose.
research.invitation.p3: What the study would get: a de-identified copy of your exam records: the questions' types and timing, how the AI and the human graders scored each topic, how disagreements between them were settled, counts and types of integrity notes, and any accommodation you had (held back where so few students share it that it could point to you). Your name, email, the words you said or typed, audio and video are never included. You appear under a study code instead of your name.
research.invitation.p4: Voice measurements are included only where your organization measures voices at all, and never for students in the European Union or EEA.
research.invitation.p5: You can change your mind at any time on the "My research choice" page (from My exams). Withdrawing stops your records going into any later copy for the study; a copy already given to the researchers cannot be called back, but it holds no name or contact details. Your exam records themselves are still kept for {0} days as the exam notice says.
research.withdrawal.title: Withdraw from the research
research.withdrawal.p1: You are withdrawing from {0}'s research. From now on none of your exam records go into a copy for the study.
research.withdrawal.p2: A copy already given to the researchers cannot be called back; it holds no name or contact details. Your exams and grades are not affected.
research.reply.notTakingPart: You are not taking part in the research, so there is nothing to withdraw.
research.reply.notRunning: Your organization is not running research at the moment.
research.reply.changed: The research notice has changed since this page was opened. Reload the page and read it again.
research.reply.notYours: That exam attempt is not yours.
research.reply.agreed: Thank you. Your de-identified exam records will be included in the research.
research.reply.declined: Saved. Your exam records will not be used for research.
research.reply.withdrawn: You have withdrawn. None of your exam records will go into any later copy for the research.
